snippet.title: Age of Wonders 4 | Launch Trailer | Last Chance to Pre-Order!
snippet.description:
Last chance to pre-order: https://www.paradoxinteractive.com/games/age-of-wonders-4/about

A brand new Age of Wonders is almost here! The newest installment in the iconic fantasy strategy game series from Triumph Studios, Age of Wonders 4, will launch on May 2, 2023 for PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X and S.
